name: 1 Thessalonians
author: The apostle Paul.
setting: Written to a young church facing persecution.
theme: Stay faithful and hopeful, for Christ will return.
christInBook: Paul writes about the coming of the Lord Jesus, when he descends from heaven, the dead in Christ rise, and we are with the Lord forever (4:16-17). Christ is the one who delivers us from the wrath to come (1:10).
howToRead: Notice that each chapter ends with the coming of Christ. Paul writes to encourage a church that is suffering and worried about loved ones who have died.
